rows.question: If the total weight of the wheelchair and the disabled person is 700N, if you want to push the disabled person and the wheelchair up a 0.02-meter-high threshold along a 1-meter portable wedge ramp in 2 seconds, and the thrust used is 150N, what is the power of the push?? What is the mechanical efficiency of the portable wedge ramp in this process? What is the friction force exerted on the wheelchair by the portable wedge ramp? (Friction between internal parts of the wheelchair is ignored)
rows.prediction:
To calculate the power of the push, we need to determine the force applied to the wheelchair and the disabled person over the 1-meter portable wedge ramp in 2 seconds.

The total weight of the wheelchair and the disabled person is 700N. The force applied to the wheelchair and the disabled person to push them up the ramp is 150N.

The power of the push is given by the force applied over the distance traveled in time:

Power = Force x Distance / Time

Power = 150N x 1m / 2s
Power = 7500 N·m/s

The mechanical efficiency of the portable wedge ramp is the ratio of the work done by the ramp to the work done by the person pushing the ramp. The work done by the person pushing the ramp is the force applied multiplied by the distance traveled:

Work done by person = Force x Distance
Work done by person = 150N x 1m = 150 N·m

The work done by the ramp is the force applied multiplied by the length of the ramp:

Work done by ramp = Force x Length of ramp
Work done by ramp = 150N x 0.02m = 3 N·m

The mechanical efficiency of the portable wedge ramp is the ratio of the work done by the ramp to the work done by the person pushing the ramp:

Mechanical efficiency = Work done by ramp / Work done by person
Mechanical efficiency = 3 N·m / 150 N·m
Mechanical efficiency = 0.02

The friction force exerted on the wheelchair by the portable wedge ramp is the difference between the force applied to the wheelchair and the force exerted by the ramp on the wheelchair. The force applied to the wheelchair is the total weight of the wheelchair and the disabled person, which is 700N. The force exerted by the ramp on the wheelchair is the force applied to the ramp by the person pushing it, which is 150N.

The friction force exerted on the wheelchair by the portable wedge ramp is the difference between these two forces:

Friction force = Force applied to wheelchair - Force exerted by ramp on wheelchair
Friction force = 700N - 150N
Friction force = 550N

The friction force exerted on the wheelchair by the portable wedge ramp is 550N.
